title: An Indonesian image app joins the catalog
summary:
A community image app joined the catalog, agent-readable API resources grew, and text API ad selection gained domain checks.

RuangRiung AI Image Generator was added to the website and README project listings. The community-built app supports Indonesian and English.

Five public metadata resources were added, covering API endpoints, models, capabilities, services and usage guidance. The API descriptions in agents.json and arazzo.json identify themselves as version 1.0.1.

Text API ad selection can now match configured domains against referrers without case sensitivity and check Origin information when a referrer is absent. Matching requests are selected for ads with 100% probability.
